metadata.guide_policy: original side knots plus first/last endpoint tangent guides; remove only paired consecutive duplicates
metadata.line_policy: convert D3 lineTo to a linear cubic with controls at one-third and two-thirds
metadata.serialization: Python repr round-trip double decimal after JavaScript arithmetic; no quantization
metadata.shape_comparison: local-chord backtracking depends on subdivision; original/candidate counts do not prove an improvement
